tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Legal identity and regulatory registrations of SMIFS Limited (CIN, SEBI broker, depository participant, research analyst and PMS numbers, AMFI, APMI, IRDAI), exchange and depository memberships, registered office, and official contact emails. Use this to verify the firm or answer "who is SMIFS".

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: All SMIFS product lines (Wealth Management, Equities & Commodities, Structured Solutions, Institutions, Insurance) with a short summary, page URL and the offerings under each (for example PMS & Advisory, Mutual Funds, Equity Derivatives, Margin Trading Facility).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details for one SMIFS product line or offering, by slug from list_products. tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Search SMIFS research and market-commentary posts by title (case-insensitive), newest first, or list the latest posts when no query is given. Returns title, publish date, URL and a short summary. Research is general information, not personalised investment advice.

tools.name: get_contact_and_grievance
tools.description: SMIFS branch offices (city, address, phone, email) and the investor grievance escalation matrix (customer care, then each escalation level), plus the SEBI SCORES and SMART ODR routes. Optionally filter branches by city.

tools.name: get_account_opening_info
tools.description: Where and how to open a SMIFS demat and trading account, the client login links (macONE), and where to find the investor charter and guide videos. Returns links only; it never starts an application.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: SMIFS at a glance as published on /aboutus: overview, headline figures (years of experience, clients served, cities), mission and vision, the milestone timeline since 1994, the leadership team (key managerial personnel, management team, team leaders) with roles, and institutional affiliations.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Keyword search across the SMIFS FAQ page and the FAQs on every product page (accounts, KYC, trading, PMS, mutual funds, charges, compliance, support). Returns matching questions with their answers, category and source URL; with no query, returns the first questions. General information, not personal

tools.description: Full text of one SMIFS research or market-commentary post, by slug or smifs.com URL (from search_research): title, publish date, author, reading time, summary and body as plain text (long posts are truncated and flagged). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_profile, list_products, get_product, search_research, get_contact_and_grievance, search_faq, get_research_post · Private data: get_company_profile, get_contact_and_grievance, list_policies_downloads · Public sink: search_research, get_contact_and_grievance, get_research_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_profile, list_products, get_product, search_research, get_contact_and_grievance, search_faq, get_research_post · Private data: get_company_profile, get_contact_and_grievance, list_policies_downloads · Public sink: search_research, get_contact_and_grievance, get_research_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
